items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: I've heard a man who's trumpet player here... His name was De Jong... Same name, but I don't know his first name

ctx.x: Pretty good jazz, I'll tell you. Thank you, with the brass band, too. That's right. They had some trumpet players in there with my father. It was under the flag. I've heard a man who's trumpet player here. Of course, this man is dead now. Yes. He got drowned. His name was De Jong. Now, what his last name was, I don't know. His name was De Jong.
Same name like Harold De Jong?
Same name, but I don't know his first name, but his name was De Jong.
